reason: Document A owns the late report and also commits to a concrete fix: deadlines go on the board calendar, a named volunteer prepares each report and a board member submits it. It also gives a way to measure results and realistic numbers (a 50% rise in the harvest months, 12% over the year). Document B apologizes up front but gives no plan to stop the late reporting from happening again, and that is my main worry about this applicant.
